snippet.title: No Man Can Deny | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist No Man Can Deny on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4632790/No_Man_Can_Deny/

No Man Can Deny is a short, atmospheric first-person horror game set alone on the open sea. With only a rusty lantern and a tape recorder, manage your limited resources, keep your nerve, and survive four distinct monsters that grow more relentless the longer you hold out.
